name: Native-Layout Sidecar Feasibility Design Doc
scope: Design-only feasibility doc — no implementation, no new runs

native_layout_findings.ggml_mul_mat_wants: [K,M] shape with ne[0]=K, ne[1]=M, !TRANSPOSE op, contiguous memory
native_layout_findings.key_unsanswered_question: Direct ggml_mul_mat(W, cur) was never actually tested — crash was in reshape, not in mul_mat

root_cause_analysis.attempt_1: Direct ggml_mul_mat crashed at ggml_can_mul_mat — reason unknown, never debugged
root_cause_analysis.attempt_2: Transpose + copy crashed at ggml_can_mul_mat with transposed W
root_cause_analysis.attempt_3: ggml_transpose + ggml_cont crashed at ggml_is_transposed assertion on result
root_cause_analysis.attempt_4: 4D reshape succeeded for mul_mat but ggml_reshape_2d on result failed

native_layout_findings.key_insight: [K,M] shape is correct for ggml_mul_mat. Issue is tensor construction (op flag or stride), not layout.

ggml_compatible.layout_needed: Same [K,M] shape, contiguous memory, no TRANSPOSE op
ggml_compatible.note: The fix may be in tensor construction, not in sidecar format

size_comparison.implication: Decoded f32 is memory-bandwidth negative vs native Q4

step_1.name: Debug Attempt 1
step_1.goal: Determine why direct ggml_mul_mat(W, cur) crashed
step_1.method: Add tensor inspection logging before ggml_mul_mat call
expected_outcomes: all pass but fails → deeper GGML issue

step_2.name: Performance measurement
step_2.goal: Compare native matmul vs custom-op PRT vs native
success_criteria: Ideally timing < Mode A (2.35s) — unlikely given 2x memory

main_risks.description: Decoded f32 ~86MB vs native Q4 ~45MB — 4-8x more memory bandwidth
PRT uses INT8 for canonicity, not compression. Decoded f32 is not compressed.
Expected: PRT with native matmul is slower than native Q4 inference
Phase 24R reshape crash suggests GGML graph building has constraints
Native-layout sidecar variant increases tooling complexity

decision_matrix.GO_NATIVE_LAYOUT_PROBE: Step 1 debug reveals simple tensor construction fix
decision_matrix.MAYBE_GGML_FORMAT_AUDIT: Step 1 debug reveals deeper GGML issue requiring reshape
decision_matrix.NO_GO_F32_TOO_LARGE: Step 2 shows decoded f32 not faster than custom-op PRT
decision_matrix.NO_GO_WORSE_THAN_NATIVE: Step 2 shows performance worse than native Q4
decision_matrix.NO_GO_FORMAT_CHANGE: Sidecar format change required for GGML path

recommended_next.description: Add tensor inspection logging to Attempt 1, run once, fix simple issues and test, or document deeper issues and stop
do_not: Generate new sidecar formats without confirming path is viable
Claim speedup before Step 2 confirms it
Proceed to multi-layer or 7B timing without clean Step 1+2 result
